headline: Guyana Offshore Oil Production Tops 1 Million Barrels per Day, Exxon Says
summary: Exxon announced that total oil production in Guyana has exceeded 1 million barrels per day. The milestone in the offshore Stabroek Block alongside Hess and CNOOC is prompting rival oil companies to pursue frontier drilling opportunities.
why: Guyana's deepwater discoveries represent one of the fastest-growing offshore crude developments in decades. Rising production expands global non-OPEC oil supply and drives revenues for consortium partners.

impacts.name: ExxonMobil
impacts.why: Exxon is the primary operator of the Stabroek Block, where output surpassed 1 million barrels per day.
